Name: Beacon01
Title: Beacon Keeper's Note
Body: I lit the beacon every night for forty winters. The last ship I saw was carrying a cartographer.
Author: Keeper

Name: Jetty01
Title: Tide Marker
Body: Mark the jetty stones at low tide. Half the year they vanish.

Name: Stones01
Title: At the Stones
Body: I do not know what these stones meant. I leave them as I found them.

Name: Spring01
Title: Spring Letter
Body: If you find this, the spring is sweet still. Drink. Rest.

Name: Shrine01
Title: Shrine Plaque
Body: Brought ashore by a wave that came twice.

Name: Tree01
Title: Burned Tree
Body: Three storms ago. The fire jumped to nothing else.

Name: Hermit01
Title: Hermit's Greeting
Body: I do not want a map. I want the island as it is. But you may stay.
Author: Hermit
